title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper Bridging the Gap Between Binary and Source Based Package Management in Spack
motivation: Ensure reproducibility and artifact quality of SC papers
method: The evaluators reviewed the artifact description from the original paper—how the authors documented the Spack software implementation. They then independently ran the code to verify that it actually produced the claimed results about binary and source-based package management. This involved comparing what the paper claimed would happen with what actually occurred when the software ran.
key_novelty: This report verifies whether the original paper's findings on Spack package management can be independently reproduced from its artifacts.
limitations: Scope limited to original paper's artifacts
